article.title: Instrument payable at specified place.
article.content: A promissory note or bill of exchange made, drawn or accepted payable at a specified place must, in order to charge the maker or drawer thereof, be presented for payment at that place.
article.html:
69Instrument payable at specified place.

Section 69 · Chapter V · page 18 of the Act

A promissory note or bill of exchange made, drawn or accepted payable at a specified place must, in order to charge the maker or drawer thereof, be presented for payment at that place.
